requests.description: Returns the secret key related to the specified public key. You must use the legacy secret key only in a 3rd party integration with legacy reCAPTCHA.
requests.name: GET /v1/{key}:retrieveLegacySecretKey
requests.note: Replace {{RECAPTCHA_ENTERPRISE_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Annotates a previously created Assessment to provide additional information on whether the event turned out to be authentic or fraudulent.
requests.name: POST /v1/{name}:annotate
requests.note: Replace {{RECAPTCHA_ENTERPRISE_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Migrates an existing key from reCAPTCHA to reCAPTCHA Enterprise. Once a key is migrated, it can be used from either product. SiteVerify requests are billed as CreateAssessment calls. You must be authenticated as one of the current owners of the reCAPTCHA Site Key, and your user must have the reCAPTCHA Enterprise Admin IAM role in the destination project.
requests.name: POST /v1/{name}:migrate
requests.note: Replace {{RECAPTCHA_ENTERPRISE_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
